up: Identify compounds selective for CDK2 over CDK1. Selection criteria: IC50 < 1000 nM for CDK2 AND IC50 > 10000 nM for CDK1. Include the canonical SMILES structure for each compound. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, preferred name, CDK2 IC50 value, and CDK1 IC50 value.
sql:
WITH cdk2_activities AS (
  SELECT
    a.molregno,
    MIN(a.standard_value) AS cdk2_ic50
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE
    td.pref_name LIKE 'Cyclin-dependent kinase 2%'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.molregno
), cdk1_activities AS (
  SELECT
    a.molregno,
    MIN(a.standard_value) AS cdk1_ic50
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE
    td.pref_name LIKE 'Cyclin-dependent kinase 1%'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.molregno
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  c2.cdk2_ic50,
  c1.cdk1_ic50,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM cdk2_activities c2
JOIN cdk1_activities c1 ON c2.molregno = c1.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON c2.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  c2.cdk2_ic50 < 1000
  AND c1.cdk1_ic50 > 10000;
